id: title:Gilbert09:keep urllib transport failures retryable and unreported

review.posthog_relevance: Adds transient network failure recovery to the Bing Ads warehouse ingestion workflow, allowing the system to distinguish between permanent configuration errors and temporary connectivity issues.
review.reason: Adds a specific URLError pattern to the retryable exceptions set and a corresponding test assertion. This demonstrates a bounded, substantive improvement in the reliability of the Bing Ads warehouse ingestion workflow by distinguishing transient network failures from permanent errors, rather than treating them as bugs. The implementation and relevant checks are visible in the diff.
review.uncertainty: The actual runtime benefit and complete context of the warehouse ingestion dependency are not fully established, but the code change itself represents a clear, localized reliability improvement.
